title: Microwave Mug Cake with Chocolate Frosting

steps.text: Measure and add-1/4 tsp vanilla extract to the bowl

steps.text: Whisk-Whisk batter until no lumps remain

steps.text: Pour-Pour batter into prepared mug

steps.text: Microwave-Microwave the mug and batter on high power for 60 seconds. Check if the cake is done by inserting and toothpick into the center of the cake and then removing it. If wet batter clings to the toothpick, microwave for an additional 5 seconds. If the toothpick comes out clean, continue

A toothpick is inserted into the center of the cake and comes out clean

steps.text: Invert-Invert the mug to release the cake onto a plate
visible_evidence: mug turned upside down over a plate
cake resting on the plate after lifting the mug

checks.text: The mug is inverted over a plate so the cake releases onto the plate

steps.text: Allow-Allow to cool until it is no longer hot to the touch

steps.text: remove-then carefully remove the paper liner

steps.text: Scoop-While the cake is cooling, prepare to pipe the frosting. Scoop 4 spoonfuls of chocolate frosting into a zip-top bag

steps.text: seal-seal zip top bag, removing as much air as possible

steps.text: cut-Use scissors to cut one corner from the bag to create a small opening 1/4 inch in diameter

steps.text: Squeeze-Squeeze the frosting through the opening to apply small dollops of frosting to the plate in a circle around the base of the cake
